prova:
classical
  intro n
  refine ⟨2 ^ n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine SimpleGraph.colorableOfColoring ?_
    refine ⟨fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
          (∏ i : Fin n, ((⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) % 2)), ?_⟩
    intro x y hxy hne
    have h : (∏ i : Fin n, ((⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) % 2)) =
        (∏ i : Fin n, ((⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) % 2)) := by simp [hne]
    simp only [dist_norm, norm_educlidean, edist_educlidean, edist_norm] at hxy
    have hdy : dist x y = 1 := by simp [hxy]
    have hle : dist x y ≤ 1 := le_of_eq hdy
    have hlt : dist x y < 2 := by linarith
    have hsq : dist x y ^ 2 < 4 := by nlinarith
    have hsum : (∑ i : Fin n, ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2) = dist x y ^ 2 := by
      simp [dist_educlidean, edist_educlidean, Real.sq_sqrt, dist_norm, norm_educlidean]
      <;> ring_nf
    have hsum_lt : (∑ i : Fin n, ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2) < 4 := by
      linarith [hsq]
    by_contra hh
    simp only [Prod.not_eq_iff_ne_or_ne] at hh
    have h_ex : ∃ i : Fin n, (⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) % 2 ≠ (⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ : ℤ) % 2 := by
      push_neg at hh
      exact hh
    rcases h_ex with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hx : (x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ) < -1 ∨ 1 < (x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ) := by
      contrapose! hi
      have hxl : ⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ = ⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ := by
        by_contra hne'
        have hwl : (x i : ℝ) ≤ ⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ + 1 := Int.floor_le (x i)
        have hwu : (⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) ≤ (x i : ℝ) := Int.lt_floor_add_one (x i)
        have hw2l : (y i : ℝ) ≤ ⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ + 1 := Int.floor_le (y i)
        have hw2u : (⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) ≤ (y i : ℝ) := Int.lt_floor_add_one (y i)
        have hdiff : (⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) - (⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) ≤ (x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ) := by
          linarith [hw2l, hwu]
        have hdiff2 : (x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ) ≤ (⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) - (⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) := by
          linarith [hwl, hw2u]
        have hdiff_eq : (⌊(x i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) - (⌊(y i : ℝ)⌋ : ℝ) = (x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ) := by
          linarith [hdiff, hdiff2]
        contrapose! hdiff_eq
        push_neg at hi
        by_contra hne2
        push_neg at hne2
        simp_all [Int.zmod_two_eq_zero_or_one]
    rcases hx with (hx | hx)
    · have hsq_one : 1 < ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [hx]
      have hsq_sum : ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, ((x j : ℝ) - (y j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j in ({i} : Set (Fin n)), ((x j : ℝ) - (y j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one]
          _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, ((x j : ℝ) - (y j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by nlinarith)
            simp
      nlinarith [hsq_sum, hsum_lt]
    · have hsq_one : 1 < ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [hx]
      have hsq_sum : ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, ((x j : ℝ) - (y j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ((x i : ℝ) - (y i : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j in ({i} : Set (Fin n)), ((x j : ℝ) - (y j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            simp [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_singleton, Nat.cast_one]
          _ ≤ ∑ j : Fin n, ((x j : ℝ) - (y j : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => by nlinarith)
            simp
      nlinarith [hsq_sum, hsum_lt]
  · have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have hsqrt : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((n : ℝ))
    have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (2 + Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ))) := by
      linarith [hsqrt]
    have h2n : (2 : ℝ) ^ (n : ℕ) ≤ (2 + Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ))) ^ (n : ℕ) := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left
      <;> nlinarith [hsqrt]
    simpa using h2n
